hypothesis: After four compound detector-miss frames, the latch-clearing fifth frame restores the generic curve supplemental brake for one control decision even though the next clear frame enables the faster clear-curve controller. Retaining only the existing softened compound brake envelope for that transition should remove a deterministic brake spike without raising target speed, changing steering, or weakening the inherited base speed brake.

scope.single_factor: On the one latch-clearing frame after a previously compound far/moderate obstacle, substitute the already-qualified compound brake envelope for the generic curve supplemental envelope.

feedback_assessment.accepted: Obstacle-local slowdown is supported by the submission12 video diagnostic, where 13 of 26 encounters lose at least 10 percent on the rendered-video speed proxy. The current code also contains a deterministic clearing-frame brake spike after every qualifying miss sequence.
feedback_assessment.rejected: Intentional off-road driving is not implemented. Official variables-6 rules terminate after 101 consecutive negative-reward actions and immediately on playfield exit; no official source grants a safe racing-line allowance outside the road. Grass friction is also lower than road friction.
feedback_assessment.unproven: The videos do not expose physical speed, action, detector phase, source hash or clearance, so they cannot justify a global target increase, weaker obstacle approach braking, more aggressive steering or shorter latch duration.

static_acceptance: Candidate and control are bit-exact before the clearing frame and reconverge immediately after it.
Only brake may differ on the registered clearing frame; candidate brake is no greater than control and no lower than inherited base brake.
All eligibility boundaries, both turn directions, both obstacle sides, reacquisition, flicker, reset, invalid input and lost-road paths are covered.
Randomized stateful differential tests prove every difference is eligible, finite and bounded with mutually exclusive gas and brake.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission tests pass.
rollback: Any target, gas or steering difference.

Any future authorized paired evaluation with lower finish count, collision, off-track, progress or clearance regression.
